title: Redirect function repaired
summary:
A maintenance day for redirects and the Text API’s ad selection logic.

The site’s redirect function was converted to ES modules to address an export error. Affiliate redirects now use one consolidated mapping instead of a duplicate file.

Ad selection now checks generated text and input messages for affiliate trigger words. A match increases the chance of a relevant ad rather than guaranteeing one.

When no relevant affiliate offer is found, Ko-fi appears 30% of the time instead of every time. Referral links also have a 10% selection chance.
